info.bio:
Meat Puppets (o The Meat Puppets) es una banda de hardcore punk, rock alternativo y folk independiente estadounidense, que influyó a algunas bandas del movimiento grunge de los 90s. La banda ganó relevancia de nuevo en dicha década cuando uno de sus seguidores, el líder del grupo de grunge Nirvana Kurt Cobain, los invitó al acústico de la banda en MTV Unplugged para versionar tres de sus canciones.

Formados en enero de 1980, en Phoenix, Arizona

scenes.name: Psicodelia del desierto
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Del desierto de Arizona surge un sonido country-psicodélico: los Meat Puppets tienden un puente entre hardcore y acid-rock y se convierten en herederos de los Grateful Dead con su «cosmic cow-punk» (Up On The Sun); Green On Red, híbrido de garage, new wave y Paisley Underground; Giant Sand de Howe Gelb y su fusión de rock, country y psicodelia. En Texas, el punk hiperpsicodélico demente de los Butthole Surfers (Psychic Powerless), una de las grandes bandas de los ochenta.

podcast.title: Chris Kirkwood's Addiction and Prison Sentence
podcast.body: Chris Kirkwood, who co-founded the Meat Puppets with his brother Kurt in 1980, developed a severe heroin addiction by the late 1990s, tragically after his wife died of an overdose in 1998. In 2003, he was involved in an altercation at a post office with an elderly woman, which led to him being clubbed by a security guard. When he attempted to flee, the guard shot him. After spending time in the hospital, he served 21 months in prison and has reportedly been clean and sober ever since. "By the end of the 90s, he was a serious heroin addict, even after his wife died of an OD in 1998."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Grunge Inspirers and Adolescent Idols
podcast.body: The Meat Puppets were chosen by Nirvana for a collaboration during their MTV Unplugged session, a "reivindicador" act. They were idols of Curcomen's adolescence and for much of the 90s grunge scene, having inspired a significant part of the movement in the early 90s. Although considered "a bit of a relic" in American rock by the mid-90s for the younger generation of Nirvana, Pearl Jam, and Soundgarden fans, they remained an important cult band. Nirvana was proud to play with their adolescent idols, creating a deeply connected and symbiotic performance that stood out from many other Unplugged collaborations. "los mid-papets habían sido unos ídolos de la adolescencia kurkomen."

xref.title: Post-Quitting Reflection and Life as a Junkie (1992-1996)
xref.body: After leaving the Red Hot Chili Peppers in 1992, John Frusciante auditioned for the Meat Puppets, but it didn't work out. He subsequently fell into a deep depression, becoming a full-fledged heroin addict. At 23, he felt his life and music career were over, and he didn't pick up a guitar for a period. For three years, he rarely left his Hollywood home, which deteriorated, covered in graffiti. He used heroin heavily, stating he was "proud to be an addict" and happy only when on drugs. He neglected to cash royalty checks, including one for $600,000, found by Flea's daughters. "I was very sad and I was always happy when I was on drugs. Therefore I should be on drugs all the time."

xref.title: Eyes Adrift Formation and Disbandment
xref.body: Following Sweet 75, Chris formed Eyes Adrift with a member of the Meat Puppets (one of Nirvana's favorite bands) and the drummer from Sublime. This band also failed to attract an audience and was finished by 2003. "That was followed by a group called Eyes Adrift, with a guy from the Meet Puppets, one of Nirvana's favorite bands, and the drummer from Sublime."
